acceptance.description: Implement versioned JSONL protocol and one XML fixture across pinned libxml2/xmloxide/BCL runners with build metadata.
Assert semantic response equality, process failure categorization, invalid requests, timeouts and offline resources.
Demonstrate the deliverable using only verified dependencies and this task; record actual API/output files and checks at the tested revision. Preserve earlier milestone behavior.

handoff.summary: Split before claim into protocol/BCL and independent pinned engine runners. This join retains all original cross-engine acceptance criteria and verifies their integrated combination.
